meta.lyra_canon: Most staff think Vira runs on ordinary automation. Only the people marked knows_lyra (a handful of senior engineers) know Lyra by name and talk to her. Nobody outside Marcus's circle knows about her choices, the dog, or the hologram.

places.saltbrush: Small desert town north of Vira on the highway; Marcus lives here. Downtown storefronts: diner, hardware, cafe, saloon, pharmacy, grocery, post office, barber, thrift store, laundry, bank, pizza place, auto parts, taco shop, bookstore, feed & seed. A gas station with a mini mart, a motel, a church, a school.
places.ironwood: Railroad and quarry town in granite hills. Main Street downtown: hardware, diner, pawn shop, auto parts, saloon, feed & supply, barber, tattoo shop, cafe, machine shop, thrift, tire shop, liquor store, bakery, bait & tackle, laundromat. Warehouses south of the tracks, a trailer park, a highway strip of motels and gas stations, a truck stop at the east end.
places.halcyon: The city: a downtown skyline, hills neighborhoods, a freeway with numbered exits. Long commute to Vira (about an hour).
places.vira: Hyperscale data center in the desert: sixteen data halls (A1 to D4) in four blocks, generator and cooling yards, a substation, a solar field, a staff lot, a front gatehouse with lift arms, and the operations building (lobby, offices, cafeteria, security office, network operations). Staff park in the lot north of the halls.
places.rules: Use these places generically ("the diner in Saltbrush"); do not invent business names, new towns or landmarks.
